'''S.W. Copplochwost''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] citizen of the [[Eternal Empire]] of [[Zakuul]] living during the [[war against Zakuul]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
S.W. Copplochwost appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' as an NPC on Zakuul.<ref name="SWTOR" />
